BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting paper billing fees; and adding a newsection to chapter 19.86 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.86 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A business entity that uses paper bills to charge customers forservices provided must provide a customer with one paper copy of thecustomer's regular bill each billing cycle at no additional cost to thecustomer. (2) The legislature finds that the practices covered by thissection are matters vitally affecting the public interest for thepurpose of applying this chapter. A violation of this section is notreasonable in relation to the development and preservation of businessand is an unfair or deceptive act in trade or commerce and an unfairmethod of competition for the purpose of applying this chapter.
